project.summary: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: a content-addressed evidence ledger (claim-to-snapshot binding, tamper-evident) plus versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory.

release.changelog: Releases 0.1.0 and 0.1.1: ctx.researchReport service seam with the byte-frozen assemble contract, content-addressed evidence ledger with tamper-evident reads, byte-level claim verification plus the optional ctx.dataQuality numeric bridge, versioned sealed reports (report.md + manifest.json) with visible [鏈牳瀹瀅/[涓庤瘉鎹煕鐩綸 markers, and the evidence_add / research_report / ledger_query model tools.

management.label: dsh-research-report profile bundle
management.instructions: Add the bundle row to the profile and restart: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-research-report` (npm tarball; install scripts stay disabled). After restart the row mounts `ctx.researchReport` and the evidence_add / research_report / ledger_query tools. Optional runtime peers are resolved via ctx.get at call time and are not required to mount.

declarations.permissions: fs:workspace-write; network:ctx-web-only (every HTTP path goes through the harness ctx.web seam); session:read; session:write; native-code:none.
declarations.testing: 69 vitest cases (9 spec files) against the real 0.1.0-rc.6 Context/Session/ToolRuntime/LocalJobRegistry/WebRuntime peers; keyless fixture end-to-end (evidence_add x3 -> sealed research_report -> tamper -> contradicted); smoke install in a scratch DSH_HOME profile; full gate: typecheck + typecheck:ci + test + build + verify:self-contained + verify:artifacts + verify:frozen-contract + verify:readme-sync + pack:check (all green).

capability.expected: provides ctx.researchReport (assemble), the evidence_add / research_report / ledger_query tools, and a content-addressed evidence ledger with tamper-evident sealed reports under the workspace
